summary: Tested the KT-V520 paper status (papierstatus) feature in the receipt-printer lamp/panel. Backend: 11/11 pytest pass. Printer WS PRINTER_STATUS/PAPER_STATUS works, aliases are mapped correctly (near_end/NEAR_END via paper_status->low, out/no_paper/paper_out->empty, normal->ok) and invalid values (bogus/null/123) are ignored. kiosk_printers.paper is stored and /kiosk/printers/online returns paper with 'ok' as default. Admin WS presence carries printers[].paper (~0.1s). Employee WS sends {type:'printers'} on connect and on every change (~0.06s). Frontend: on the employee kiosk (Anita PIN, 768px) and the admin kiosk (1920px) the lamp goes ok(green) -> low(amber, animate-pulse, 'Papier bijna op — vervang binnenkort de rol') -> empty(red, pulse, 'Papier leeg — vervang de rol') -> ok(green, warning gone). Updates arrive live without reload, about 0.5s on employee and 0.5-2.6s on admin. Local APK path: onKtpPaperStatus('empty') sets localStorage ktp_paper=empty, the lamp turns red with the warning and the server paper becomes empty. A postMessage PAPER_STATUS near_end gives low, the status survives a reload, and 'ok' resets it. One real bug found: when the printer drops offline, the lamp falls back to stale data.

minor.issue: Backend maps 'none'->empty, frontend ktp-printer.js doesn't (inconsistent; 'none' as empty is also ambiguous)
Paper value persists across disconnects; a stale 'empty' stays until the APK reports again on reconnect (web client resends only if ktp_paper in localStorage — OK, but native/other clients may not)

ui_bugs.issue: When the KT-V520 disconnects, the server pushes printers:[] but `live.length ? live : fetched` falls back to the stale REST list loaded at page start. Repro: employee kiosk, paper low (amber), kill printer WS -> lamp turns GREEN 'Bonprinter verbonden' with paper 'ok' for up to 30s (verified 16s+). The lamp shows the wrong state: it says connected and drops the paper warning while the printer is offline.

issues: Row aggregates the worst paper of all online printers; with 2 printers (one empty, one ok) the lamp is red 'Papier leeg' even though one printer works, and it only names ktp[0]. Consider listing per-printer rows.

action_items: Fix PrinterLamp useKtpOnline: once a live 'printers'/'presence' message has arrived, use the live list even if it is empty (e.g. track a printersKnown flag in kiosk-live state, or write the live list into `fetched`), so the lamp does not show green with stale paper=ok after the printer goes offline

rca of the issue: PrinterLamp.jsx useKtpOnline returns `live.length ? live : fetched`. An empty live list (printer offline) is treated the same as 'no live data yet', so it falls back to the `fetched` REST snapshot (polled every 30s). That snapshot still lists the printer online with paper 'ok'. Fix: tell 'not received' apart from 'received empty'.
